violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Observed handle of cheese scoop in cheese in the cold hold unit.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Observed items in refrigerator and cold hold unit that ere not date marked.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Observed duct tape on walk in cooler door. Duct tape is not a cleanable surface.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed dried food in public use microwave.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Observed dust hanging from ceiling in food prep area.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Observed open bags of food in walk in freezer.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Observed duct tape on walk in cooler door. duct tape is not a cleanable surface.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Observed heavy powder build up in chutes of dispenser.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Observed boxes of single service items on floor in storage area.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Observed food in hand sink upon arrival.
